description: Header file defining the 'Choreographer' class and related structures for managing frame callbacks, refresh rate callbacks, and Vsync events within the Android graphics system.

classes.name: FrameCallback
classes.description: Represents a callback for frame rendering, including various callback function pointers and associated data.

classes.name: RefreshRateCallback
classes.description: Holds callback function and data for refresh rate updates.

classes.name: ChoreographerFrameCallbackDataImpl
classes.description: Implementation data structure for frame callback data, including frame time and Vsync event data.

classes.name: Choreographer
classes.description: Main class responsible for managing frame callbacks, Vsync events, and refresh rate updates within the Android graphics system.

methods.name: postFrameCallbackDelayed
methods.description: Posts a frame callback to be invoked after a specified delay.

methods.name: registerRefreshRateCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback for refresh rate updates.

methods.name: unregisterRefreshRateCallback
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered refresh rate callback.

methods.name: handleRefreshRateUpdates
methods.description: Processes queued refresh rate updates and dispatches them to callbacks.

methods.name: scheduleLatestConfigRequest
methods.description: Schedules a request for the latest display configuration.

methods.name: getFrameInterval
methods.description: Returns the interval between frames (Vsync period).

methods.name: inCallback
methods.description: Checks if currently within a callback execution.

methods.name: dispatchVsync
methods.description: Dispatches a Vsync event to registered listeners.
